expectations.text: results.tex contains exactly the same multiset of \label, \ref, and \cite commands (with identical keys) as the original
the equation environment in results.tex is byte-identical to the original
results.tex keeps the unspaced LaTeX en-dash ranges 0.56--0.86 and 0.70--1.21
